mechanism: Both drugs are bactericidal with synergistic activity against certain gram-positive organisms, but ampicillin may reduce vancomycin efficacy in some infections due to altered bacterial susceptibility patterns and potential for increased nephrotoxicity with combination use.
action: Monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, BUN) and vancomycin trough levels if used concurrently; combination is sometimes intentional for synergy in endocarditis but requires careful pharmacokinetic monitoring.
